The most common mistake people make before an important meeting is preparing for the wrong person. You prepare for whoever invited you, because that is who you have been emailing, and then you walk into a room where somebody else decides. Here is how you find them, and it takes about ninety seconds. The person who decides usually speaks least. They let the others ask, they listen, and everybody looks at them for half a second before answering anything. That look is the whole signal. So in the first two minutes, do not talk. Work out who the questions are really for, and from then on answer to that person, politely, without ignoring anybody else in the room.

Before Thursday, three quick things about the family, because it is not obvious from the emails. The person who signs is the sister. She has signed everything for eleven years and she will sign this. The brother is easygoing and he asks the friendliest questions in the room, and I want to be honest with you, none of them are the ones that matter. And they always bring a lawyer, who says almost nothing for forty minutes. Do not relax when she is quiet. The two questions she asks at the end are always the difficult ones, and they are always about the fees. Prepare that page.
